A new viral clip shows a man testing his AI humanoid at home — and it’s chaos. The robot stumbles, drops dishes, and accidentally smashes a mirror while trying to “help” clean. It’s part comedy, part cautionary tale. For now, buying a humanoid still feels like joining a beta test with legs. The video is a reminder that even with all the hype, real-world AI still struggles with real-world physics. The performance was going perfectly... until the ending 😭 China's Unitree humanoid robot steps onto the stage with surprisingly smooth choreography, hitting the moves with impressive balance, timing, and coordination. For a moment, it genuinely feels like a glimpse into the future. Then everything falls apart. One small mistake turns an elegant performance into an instant viral moment, with the robot collapsing in spectacular fashion right before the finish. That's what makes humanoid robotics so fascinating right now. The technology has advanced enough to create moments that feel almost unbelievable, but it's still unpredictable enough to remind everyone that these machines aren't quite ready to replace us.
